newsitem.title: LATVIA: Daugavpils dominates lively Latvian bourse.
newsitem.headline: Daugavpils dominates lively Latvian bourse.

text.p: The Daugavpils chain motor factory rose amid lively trade at Latvia's bourse on Tuesday, the Riga Stock Exchange said.
Overall market volume soared to 169,000 lats from 130,000 lats at the previous session last Thursday.
Daugavpils was the most active listing with 92,430 lats worth of its shares changing hands. Its price rose by 5.83 percent to 1.27 lats.
Market leader Unibanka recovered a bit of the ground it lost last week with its price rising from 1.94 lats to 1.95 lats in trade of 26,323 lats.
